hero.intro: Front-end developer with 3 years of experience owning projects from planning to launch. I build fast, maintainable admin systems with React, Vite, TypeScript and Next.js, bridge product and engineering with Figma, work fluently with RESTful APIs, and use AI tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot in my daily workflow.
